validation_notes: The chart shows a clear downtrend from late April through mid-June bottoming near 4.3-4.5, followed by a basing/consolidation period from mid-June to late July, and then a sharp breakout rally in early August with a large volume spike (price jumping from ~4.6 to ~5.8).
